acquisition_mechanism: Anonymous read-only Docker Hub Registry V2 manifest/config metadata requests; no image layers pulled.

license_metadata.base_distribution: Debian Bookworm; individual package licenses vary
license_metadata.note: This is not a complete per-layer SBOM/license inventory; downstream redistribution requires the applicable notices for all included software.
license_metadata.python: PSF license stack; Python 3 licensing reference https://www.python.org/psf/summary/

retrieval_reproducibility.metadata_re_resolution: Two independent tag-to-index/platform resolutions matched; selected manifest and config were fetched by digest.

store_readiness_prerequisite.basis: Operator-established current task context; not re-probed during image metadata admission.

build_requirements: OCI-compatible build engine outside the validator runtime
suitability.credential_screen: Config metadata contains no application credentials; GPG_KEY is a public signing-key fingerprint. Filesystem/layer content was not pulled or scanned.
suitability.default_user: root (image config has no User; final validator image must set and verify a non-root user)
suitability.package_manager_family: Debian Bookworm (apt/dpkg family; no runtime package installation authorized)
suitability.runtime_services: No service entrypoint or exposed ports in image config.
suitability.selection_notes: Matches the existing Python 3.12 validator runtime evidence while using the official slim Bookworm variant; final validator hardening and non-root execution remain acceptance requirements.

upstream_source_provenance.upstream_project: Python Docker Official Image; maintained by Docker Community

verifier_identity: Codex operator session; local metadata verifier
